title: A System 1 Decision Model for Medical Multiple-Choice Questions Built on Frozen Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A System 1 model answers a multiple-choice question in a single pass. A frozen language model turns the question and each option into vectors, two small, trained heads place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins. The design has been shown on agent decisions, but we are not aware of a study of how far it goes on exam questions that need medical knowledge, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. We rebuilt the recipe from scratch for MedMCQA and trained only two projection heads and one temperature on top of frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B and Qwen3-8B, using a contrastive loss with in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors, both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, where chance is 25.0%). translated_title: 基于冻结语言模型的医学多选题“系统1”决策模型
translated_abstract: “系统1”模型在单次前向传递中回答多选题。冻结的语言模型将问题和每个选项转换为向量，两个经过训练的小型头将它们映射到共享空间中，距离最近的选项即为答案。该设计已在智能体决策中得到验证，但据我们所知，尚无研究探讨该方法在需要医学知识的考试题目上能走多远——在这类题目中，正确选项与问题的相似度往往并不比错误选项更高。我们为MedMCQA从头重建了该方法，仅在冻结的Qwen3.5-0.8B、Granite-4.2-3B和Qwen3-8B模型之上训练两个投影头和一个温度参数，采用带有批内负样本和困难负样本的对比损失，并使用掩码处理重复答案。使用简单的末词元向量时，两个小型编码器在3,842个保留题目上约每三题答对一题（准确率分别为33.1%和33.0%，而随机猜测的基线为25.0%）。通过将每段文本嵌入单词摘要提示中并降低学习率……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究首次将基于冻结语言模型的单次“系统1”决策方法应用于需要医学知识的MedMCQA考试题，仅通过训练两个小型投影头和温度参数，就在小型模型上取得了显著高于随机水平的答题准确率。
en_tdlr: This study is the first to apply the frozen-language-model single-pass System 1 decision approach to medical-knowledge exam questions (MedMCQA), achieving accuracy well above chance on small models by training only two projection heads and a temperature parameter.
